title: fix-network component diagram
description: The fix-network crate: one binary built from src/, which reaches the Mac only through macOS's own network commands and the network itself.

components.name: fix-network sources
components.responsibility: Command line, snapshot, checks, repair, report and machine access.

components.name: macOS network commands
components.responsibility: networksetup, scutil, ifconfig, netstat, route, ipconfig, sysctl, sw_vers, ping, dig, curl, dscacheutil, killall, arp and sudo.

components.name: Network endpoints
components.responsibility: The public-internet probes, the internal hosts given with --internal-host, DNS servers asked directly, and the system proxies and PAC file.

relationships.description: Reads and changes network settings by running them (sys.rs).
Name lookups and TCP probes (sys.rs), and HTTP probes through curl.
